events.name: Global Tech & Industrial Automation Expo 2026
events.description: Premier international commercial beta virtual trade show featuring next-generation robotics, spatial 3D showcases, and AI solutions.

booths.name: Apex Robotics Global Innovation
booths.description: Next-generation industrial automation, collaborative robotics, and precision logistics solutions for smart factories.

booths.name: BioTech Innovations Corp
booths.description: Advanced molecular diagnostic equipment, automated laboratory liquid handlers, and sterile cell culture bioprocessors.

booths.name: Wilo Intelligent Water & Pump Solutions
booths.tagline: Pioneering for You — Smart B2B Trade Show Experience
booths.description: Explore high-efficiency circulation pumps, industrial pressure boosting, smart HVAC hydronics, and automated building water management systems in an interactive virtual showroom.

products.name: Apex-Arm X9 Modular Industrial Cobot
products.description: High-precision 6-axis collaborative robotic arm with 15kg payload and sub-millimeter positioning repeatability.

products.name: Apex-Nav AGV Autonomous Mobile Robot
products.description: LiDAR-guided smart warehouse transport robot with 500kg towing capacity and fleet management integration.

products.name: BioScan Micro-Array Fast Analyzer
products.description: Automated 96-well fluorescent plate reader for rapid biomolecular diagnostic screening.

products.name: Smart Circulation Pump (Wilo-Stratos MAXO)
products.shortDescription: Smart glandless circulation pump with integrated Bluetooth and energy analytics.
products.demoDescription: Next-generation intelligent glandless circulator pump for hot-water heating systems of all kinds, air-conditioning circuits, and closed cooling systems.

products.name: High-Efficiency Inline Pump (Wilo-Stratos GIGA)
products.shortDescription: High-efficiency glanded inline pump with electronic motor regulation.
products.demoDescription: High-efficiency inline monobloc pump with EC motor for water heating, cooling, and district energy distribution networks.

products.name: Industrial Pressure Booster (Wilo-SiBoost Smart)
products.shortDescription: Fully automated multi-pump pressure boosting system with smart inverter control.
products.demoDescription: Highly efficient multi-pump pressure booster system featuring 2 to 4 vertical multistage stainless steel pumps with EC motors.

products.name: Building Water Management System (Wilo-Nexus)
products.shortDescription: Integrated water intake, treatment, and distribution automation platform.
products.demoDescription: Cloud-enabled intelligent water management system connecting pumps, sensors, valves, and flow meters with real-time SCADA telemetry.

products.name: HVAC Circulation System (Wilo-Yonos MAXO)
products.shortDescription: Compact high-efficiency pump with LED display for heating and cooling.
products.demoDescription: Standard high-efficiency circulator with ECM technology and integrated differential pressure control for collective housing and offices.

products.name: Intelligent Pump Controller (Wilo-CC Smart)
products.shortDescription: Multi-pump automation switchboard with touchscreen HMI and remote telemetry.
products.demoDescription: Comfort controller for electronic, continuously variable speed control of direct-on-line or inverter pumps.

products.name: Industrial Water Transfer System (Wilo-DrainLift M)
products.shortDescription: Heavy-duty wastewater lifting unit with macerator and gas-tight collection tank.
products.demoDescription: Compact sewage lifting unit with single or double pump operation for sewage containing faeces below the backflow level.

products.name: Energy Optimization Platform (Wilo-Care Cloud)
products.shortDescription: AI-driven cloud intelligence service for continuous pump efficiency and anomaly detection.
products.demoDescription: Cloud-based monitoring solution offering operational reliability, remote diagnostic insight, and maintenance alerts across global pump fleets.
